mainEntity.name: How much does custom software development in India cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on scope, integrations and team size. Ladder7 offers enterprise-grade quality at affordable, flexible pricing: a fixed quote for defined projects, a monthly fee for dedicated teams, or time and materials, agreed after a short discovery call.

mainEntity.name: Is it safe to outsource software development to India?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, when the contract and process are right. Ladder7 works under an NDA, assigns code and IP to you, keeps code in your repository, and gives you access to staging environments and sprint demos throughout.

mainEntity.name: How long does a custom software project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A focused MVP usually takes 8 to 16 weeks. Larger business systems run in phases, with a usable release in each phase rather than one launch at the end.

mainEntity.name: Can you work with our existing developers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can take full ownership of a product or add engineers to your team through staff augmentation.

mainEntity.name: Do you only work with clients in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Ladder7 has clients in the UAE, the UK (London), Germany, Ireland, the USA, Singapore, Australia, Vietnam and India, and takes on projects across the GCC, Europe and Africa, working remotely with meetings in your business hours.

sections.description:
Custom software development is the design and build of an application around one company's own workflows, data and customers, instead of adapting a packaged product. It usually covers discovery, UX design, engineering, testing, cloud deployment and ongoing support.

Companies choose custom software when off-the-shelf tools force workarounds, when several systems need to share data, or when the software itself is part of what they sell.

paragraphs: Cost, talent and time zones

India has one of the largest software engineering workforces in the world, and Kerala's IT parks (including Technopark and Kinfra in Trivandrum and Infopark in Kochi) add a stable, lower-attrition talent pool. For buyers in the Gulf, Europe and Africa that means three practical advantages:

content.text: Why companies outsource custom software to India

India has one of the largest software engineering workforces in the world, and Kerala's IT parks (including Technopark and Kinfra in Trivandrum and Infopark in Kochi) add a stable, lower-attrition talent pool. For buyers in the Gulf, Europe and Africa that means three practical advantages:
Lower total cost than hiring locally in Dubai, Riyadh, London, Berlin or Johannesburg, without dropping to junior-only teams.
Working-hour overlap: India is 1.5 hours ahead of the UAE, 2.5 hours ahead of Saudi Arabia and Kenya, and 3.5 to 5.5 hours ahead of the UK, Western Europe and Nigeria.
English-first delivery, with written specifications, demos every sprint and direct access to the engineers doing the work.
